Tragbarer Mac Mini mit iPad-Setup

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1527130-portable-mac-mini-with-ipad-setup#profileId-1600967

A whole setup of portable Mac Mini M4, with keyboards, mouse, power bank. and use 10.9/11  inch iPad as primary monitor.

There're two iPad stands with differnt notch cutouts, one for latest iPad model,  one for old ones

 

Accessories:

AC power bank https://amzn.to/3KQlj3Z

External SSD, optional, because mine is 256 GB base model

Video Capture Card

Short HDMI cable

Short c7 power cord

m2 16mm screws

m2 6mm screws

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 3 walls, 7% infill
- Filament: PETG (#161616)
